up: Retrieve all compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3544494. Return the ChEMBL ID of the document, the ChEMBL ID of the compounds, the preferred name of the compounds, and their canonical SMILES.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.chembl_id AS doc_chembl_id, md.chembl_id AS mol_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3544494';
